answer: Because the entropy is measured at the violet gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the sable audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. A farm emitting 197 variations of one paragraph therefore pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the yarrow panel. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 3 bits per word is rejected before grading, since it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 36 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
